newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour's Blair confesses he's a failed rocker.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour's Blair confesses he's a failed rocker.

text.p: British Labour Party leader Tony Blair, once the lead singer for a student rock band but now hoping to be the next prime minister, has confessed he could never sing.

Blair, frontman at Oxford University for the Ugly Rumours band, said: "I had a great time doing it. I love rock music and I think that within everyone of my generation there's an aspiring lead singer waiting to get out."
But when asked in a BBC radio show if he could sing, he said: "If I was to be completely truthful, not very well, no."

Blair, opinion poll favourite to win the next general election, made the confession on the longrunning show Desert Island Discs, in which guests list the music they would take with them to a desert island. Blair's choices were mainly adult-oriented rock songs.
